entities.summary: Mark Reed Levin is a conservative American broadcast news analyst, columnist, lawyer, political commentator, radio personality, and writer. He is the host of syndicated radio show The Mark Levin Show, as well as Life, Liberty & Levin on Fox News. Previously, Levin worked in the administration of President Ronald Reagan and was chief of staff for Attorney General Edwin Meese. He is the former president of the Landmark Legal Foundation, an author of seven books, and contributor to media outlets such as National Review Online. Since 2015, Levin has been editor-in-chief of the Conservative Review.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a key advisor to President Ronald Reagan and former chief of staff for Attorney General Edwin Meese, Mark Levin played a significant role in shaping conservative politics in the United States. His influence can be seen in the subsequent appointments made by President George H.W. Bush and his continued advocacy through various media outlets.
